title: A new group in the Riordan family of matrix groups: the Sprugnoli group
summary: We define a group of lower-triangular matrices whose columns are defined by power series. This group can be seen as a generalization of the (ordinary) Riordan group and the double Riordan group. Elements of this group are defined by three power series. Sequence bisections and vertically stretched Riordan arrays play an important role in the formulation of this group. We give a production matrix characterization of this new group.
